name: speech-to-text
title_zh: 音频视频里的每句话，落成带时间轴的文字稿
tagline_zh: 开会录音、采访视频、外语播客——不用再反复拖动进度条猜内容。直接丢文件进来，它把说话声变成可搜索、可复制的逐字稿。
tagline_en: Stop scrubbing recordings to find what was said. Drop in audio or video, get a searchable, copyable transcript.
desc_en: Use this skill whenever the user wants to transcribe audio to text, convert speech to text, or get a transcript from an audio or video file. Triggers include: any mention of 'transcribe', 'transcription', 'speech to text', 'STT', 'convert audio to text', 'what does this audio say', 'get transcript', 'subtitle generation', or requests to extract spoken words from a file. Also use when the user want
why_zh: 不是简单调一个云端 API 就完事。它本地先做语音检测，再分段送识别，能扛住嘈杂环境、多人对话和口音。
why_en: Not just a cloud API wrapper. It does local voice activity detection, then chunks audio for robust recognition—handles noise.
limit_zh: 只认清晰人声，音乐、重混响或远场录音识别率会明显下降。输出是纯文本和 SRT 字幕，不做说话人分离，也不翻译。
limit_en: Clear speech only—music, heavy reverb, or far-field audio degrades accuracy. Outputs plain text & SRT, no speaker diarization or translation. Long.
title_en: Turn any audio/video into timestamped text
